wholePhysicalScope: The named 47-point podium and independent eight-point tower at Q986382 are mapped together with all three separate roof structures and the podium skylight. The registered address and waterfront agree with the hotel’s official record.
lodDetails: Four levels preserve the Shamian river podium and angled guestroom tower. Near detail includes balcony modules, glazing, crown and entry canopy.
limitations: The podium bay rhythm, white facing materials, and balcony dimensions are reconstructed from the published photograph, official written context and outlines. Glazing and panel patterns on faces beyond the photograph are approximate.
Shamian’s public embankment, waterfront landscaping, detached structures, hotel interior and approach viaduct beyond the attached entrance are outside the selected scope.
